dontShowMessage: Do not show this message again
fullScreenExitBtnDesc: Clicking this button exits the full screen mode.
fullScreenEnterBtnDesc: Clicking this button enters the full screen mode.
termsAndConditions11: Malfunction voids all pays and plays.
AutoplayNotPossible: Auto Spin cannot be started. Please check your balance and any applicable spending limits.
LowBalanceError: Insufficient balance to place the bet.
BBLowBalanceError: Insufficient balance to purchase the Buy Feature.
FSExitTextForMaxCapReached: You have won {{text1}} from Free Spins and reached the maximum win cap.
buyBonus1: Selecting Buy Feature opens the Buy Feature interface, where the player can choose the available feature settings.
buyBonus2: Pressing the Buy Feature confirm button starts the feature-triggering spin at the selected bet.
buyBonus3: The feature-triggering spin awards any applicable winnings resulting from the triggering symbol combination.
buyBonus4: After the Buy Feature ends, the bet reverts to the value selected before the feature was purchased.
turboSpin1: Clicking the Turbo button enables or disables Turbo Spin.
turboSpin2: When Turbo Spin is enabled, spin durations are reduced and win animations are displayed more quickly.
autospin1: On desktop devices, click and hold the Play button for 2 seconds to open the Auto Spin menu. Select the desired number of auto spins to begin.
autospin2: On mobile devices, tap and hold the Play button for 2 seconds to open the Auto Spin menu. Select the desired number of auto spins, then tap Start to begin.
autospin3: The player may set a stop condition based on a selected spend limit within the Auto Spin menu.
autospin4: During Auto Spin, the panel displays the total number of selected spins, the remaining spins, and the total win for the current Auto Spin session.
autospin5: Auto Spin ends automatically when the selected number of spins has been completed.
autospin6: The player may also press the Stop button to end Auto Spin at any time.
autospin7: Auto Spin allows multiple game rounds to be played automatically.
autospin8: Auto Spin can be stopped at any time.
autospin9: The Auto Spin panel contains Start and Cancel buttons for confirming or cancelling the selected Auto Spin settings.
paytableText3: Paytable values are displayed based on the currently selected total bet.
paytableText4: Select any symbol on the reels to view its paytable information.
termsAndConditions2: If a game is interrupted during play, it may enter a suspended state. When the player re-enters a suspended game, play resumes from the last successfully recorded action.
termsAndConditions4: Participation in the Online Games is subject to the applicable game rules and the Operator's terms and conditions.
termsAndConditions10: If the game remains inactive for 7 days, it may reset to its default state. Any unfinished progress, including collection features, uncompleted Free Spins, or incomplete bonus rounds, may be forfeited and not restored.
stoButtonDesc: Pressing the "Stop Auto" button disables the Autoplay mode. This button is enabled in both Autoplay mode and during normal spins.
betButtonDesc: Opens the bet selection panel, where the player can choose from the available bet options. The currently selected bet is displayed in this area.
turboDisableDesc: Pressing this button disables Turbo Spin.
turboEnableDesc: Pressing this button enables Turbo Spin.
gameInfoButtonDesc: Opens the game rules, paytable, and additional game information.
soundButtonDesc: Pressing the sound button turns game audio on or off, depending on the current setting.
closeButtonDesc: Pressing this button closes the current screen and returns the player to the previous screen.
depositButtonDesc: Opens the deposit page, where available.
winnerCupButtonDesc: Displays the winners list, where available.
buyBonusButtonDesc: Pressing this button opens the Buy Feature option, where available.
betValueButtonDesc: Displays the player's currently selected bet value in the active currency.
balanceButtonDesc: Displays the player's current available balance.
betText1: Bets are placed in the selected currency.
betText2: The bet can be adjusted using the bet button or the bet menu.
betText3: The total bet is displayed in the bet field and applies to all active winning combinations.
betText4: Each spin is played at the currently selected bet amount. The bet may be adjusted within the minimum and maximum stake limits available in the game.
spinButtonDesc: Pressing the Play button starts a game round. Holding the button opens the Auto Spin menu.
playText1: Press the Play button to start a game round at the currently selected bet.
winText1: Wins are awarded for qualifying symbol combinations on adjacent reels from left to right.
winText2: Wins are paid according to the paytable and displayed in the win field.
winText3: Only the highest win for each active way is paid.
winText5: A win occurs when 3 or 4 identical symbols land on adjacent reels starting from the leftmost reel, regardless of row position.
quickSpinText1: Enable Quick Spin to speed up gameplay.
quickSpinText2: Quick Spin may not be available in some jurisdictions.
quickStopText1: Press the spin button again to stop the reels early.
quickStopText2: Quick Stop may not be available in some jurisdictions.
menuButtonDesc: Opens the menu, which may contain options such as Game Rules, Transaction History, Sound Settings, Game History, Lobby, Deposit, and Promotions, depending on availability.
howtoPlay1: Press the spin button or the space bar to start a game round.
howtoPlay2: Press the Bet button to open the bet panel. Use the available controls to increase or decrease the bet, then close the panel to return to the main game screen.
howtoPlay5: Press the Information button to view the game rules and paytable.
howtoPlay6: Press the sound icon to enable or disable game audio. The same applies to ambient sound and sound effects, where available.
howtoPlay3: Press the Menu or Settings button to access available options such as Lobby, Transaction History, Sound Settings, Game Rules, Splash Screen Settings, Game History, Deposit, and Promotions.
howtoPlay4: Pressing History in the menu or settings displays details of recent game rounds, including spin results, bet amount, win amount, date and time, and any triggered features.
termsAndConditions9: Persistent game data may be retained for up to 90 days, after which it may be removed.
maxCapReachedBaseGame: Congratulations! Your win for this game round exceeded the maximum payable win limit. In accordance with the game rules, the maximum payable amount of {{text1}} has been credited to your account.
configError: The game is not configured in this currency. Please contact the game developer.
maxWinRule1: Winnings are capped at {{text1}} in both the base game and Free Spins. If total winnings in a Free Spins round or base game reach this limit, the maximum amount of {{text1}} will be credited to the main balance.
maxWinRule2: Winnings are capped at {{text1}} in the base game. If your total winnings from a Spin round reach this limit, the maximum amount of {{text1}} will be credited to the main balance.
tc11: The theoretical Return to Player (RTP) for this game is {{text1}}%
bbRTP: The theoretical Return to Player (RTP) for {{text1}} is {{text2}}%.
generic_error: An error occurred. Please try again later.
config_missing_error: This game is not available for the selected currency or country. Please contact support.
session_expired_error: Your session has expired. Please close this window and log in again to continue.
another_session_exist_error: Another game session is already active. Please close the active session and try again.
bet_invalid_error: Invalid bet amount. Please select a valid bet amount.
minimum_bet_error: The bet amount must be equal to or greater than the minimum allowed bet.
maximum_bet_error: The bet amount must be equal to or less than the maximum allowed bet.
game_inactive_error: This game is currently unavailable. Please try again later or contact support.
game_round_completed_error: This game round has already been completed. Please start a new round.
networkDisconnectedMessage: The game connection was interrupted. Please check your internet connection. Your game round, if already started, will be completed according to the game rules.
buyBonus5: The Free Spins Purchase feature allows you to buy direct entry into the Free Spins Round for 100x your total bet.
secondaryWaitingText: Please wait, loading feature game assets
promoFStxt2: Free Spins will be played at
anteBet1: Players can choose their preferred bet multiplier, unlocking unique gameplay advantages with each option.
